title: Yellowed Chewy Portuguese Peanut Bake
description: A roasted, chewy, energizing Portuguese dish featuring peanut butter, this bake is perfect for a snack or dessert. It is dairy-free-friendly, making it accessible to those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the peanut butter, honey, eggs, vanilla extract, and salt until smooth.
In a separate bowl, mix together the oats and chopped peanuts.
Add the oat mixture to the peanut butter mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour in the melted coconut oil and mix until a dough forms.
Press the dough into a baking dish lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely before slicing and serving.
